question: When should the mūrti-yāga be performed and how should a wise person treat all yoga-parvans?
premises: The mūrti-yāga should be performed on a yoga-parvan.
It should be performed in every way.
A wise person should honor all days called yoga-parvans with mūrti-yāga.
inference: Every yoga-parvan is an appropriate occasion for the full performance of mūrti-yāga.
plain_english: The mūrti-yāga should certainly be performed on a yoga-parvan; the wise person should honor all days called yoga-parvans with the mūrti-yāga.
